Location must stay exact.

Franklin city-limit profiles are core. Nearby organizations may participate as Franklin-area organizations when relevant, but the profile must show the actual city or service area.

Membership uses the exact profile.

When you arrive here from a directory listing, Franklin carries that exact profile into secure membership setup. Your account still must be verified as authorized for the profile before checkout opens.
